diagnosis: The financial metrics endpoint calls stripe.balance.retrieve with stripeAccountId taken directly from the URL parameter without checking if the authenticated user owns that connected account. Any vendor can view pending and available financial balances, currencies, and revenue flow of other merchants on the platform.
